```{r}
pacman::p_load("tidyverse","here", "lmerTest", "sjPlot","broom.mixed", "kableExtra", "ggeffects", "gt", "brms", "bayestestR","ggdist", "pheatmap", "heatmaply","pheatmap","gplots","RColorBrewer", "tm", "wordcloud", "psych", "wesanderson","patchwork", "broom.mixed", "dplyr", "gtsummary","ordinal","r2glmm")
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JacobElder/MiscellaneousR/master/corToOne.R")
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JacobElder/MiscellaneousR/master/plotCommAxes.R")
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JacobElder/MiscellaneousR/master/named.effects.ref.R")

here::i_am("Combined/indDiffs.qmd")
```

```{r}
fullShort1 <- arrow::read_parquet(here("Study 1","Data","shortEpMNet.parquet"))
fullShort2 <- arrow::read_parquet(here("Study 2","Data","shortEpMNet2.parquet"))
fullShort3 <- arrow::read_parquet(here("Study 3","Data","shortEpMNetC3.parquet"))

fullShort1[sapply(fullShort1, is.infinite)] <- NA
fullShort2[sapply(fullShort2, is.infinite)] <- NA
fullShort3[sapply(fullShort3, is.infinite)] <- NA
```

# Number of Identities

## Study 1

```{r}
fullShort1 %>% select(numID, MAIA:NFC) %>% corToOne(., "numID")
fullShort1 %>% select(numID, MAIA:NFC) %>% plotCorToOne(., "numID")
```

## Study 2

```{r}
fullShort2 %>% select(numID, CESD:NFC) %>% corToOne(., "numID")
fullShort2 %>% select(numID, CESD:NFC) %>% plotCorToOne(., "numID")
```

## Study 3

```{r}
fullShort3 %>% select(numID, CESD:NFC) %>% corToOne(., "numID")
fullShort3 %>% select(numID, CESD:NFC) %>% plotCorToOne(., "numID")
```
